title: Booking (raw) v1
description: The payload accepted on the booking.raw topic, exactly as produced by the upstream booking system before enrichment. Field names and types are derived verbatim from SPEC.md section 4 ("Raw booking (booking.raw)"). This is the producer's published contract for what the enrichment service accepts.

bookingId.description: Unique booking identifier. Also used as the Kafka message key on all three topics (SPEC section 3/4). Example: "BKG-12345". SPEC.md does not specify a format/pattern beyond "string", so none is enforced here.

origin.description: Origin city as supplied by the upstream system, uncorrected (may be misspelled, mis-cased, or blank/whitespace-only). Matched against the reference city list per SPEC section 5.

destination.description: Destination city as supplied by the upstream system, uncorrected (may be misspelled, mis-cased, or blank/whitespace-only). Matched against the reference city list per SPEC section 5.

mode.description: Transport mode, e.g. "ROAD", "RAIL", "AIR", "OCEAN" (observed in sample data). SPEC.md section 4 does not constrain this to an enumerated set of values, so it is left as an open string here rather than inventing a closed list.

requestedDate.description: Requested booking date, ISO-8601 calendar date, e.g. "2026-09-05". SPEC.md shows this shape but does not state a format contract explicitly; "format": "date" is included as a non-enforced annotation consistent with every example in SPEC.md and the sample data.
